description: Integration wiring: connect mcp_traffic_fingerprints.py (built 2026-04-22) into mcp_scanner.py when scanning candidate server responses for MCP protocol confirmation. mcp_traffic_fingerprints exports detect_mcp_methods, is_mcp_traffic, extract_session_indicators. Scanner should call these on HTTP responses to confirm JSON-RPC MCP traffic before storing candidate. Pure library integration — no new daemon, no network, no DB writes.
